subject: Weekend setup for Saturday install
text: I'm planning to arrive at the site at 8:45 on Saturday, bring my own tools, and work for about three hours unless the mounting bracket turns out to be stripped. Please leave the side gate unlocked and put a cone behind your car so the van has room to pull in. I'd rather finish the panel swap and cable check before lunch, because the afternoon forecast looks rainy and I don't want to work in wet conditions. There is one small technical issue to solve first: the existing switcher port keeps dropping the signal intermittently, so I'll need to test the spare line before we confirm the final connection. If you have the short HDMI extender, bring it; if not, I can pick one up on the way, but that will delay us by maybe fifteen minutes. Once the test run is complete, I'll label everything and leave a quick note about the new port mapping. If you need me to start later, let me know by Friday evening. I won't use the kitchen while I'm there, and I'll remove the old parts with me rather than leaving them for disposal. I'll also bring a spare power strip and a flashlight in case the rear closet is dark. That should keep things simple and reduce surprises. Thanks for arranging access, and if anything changes with the gate code, just send a short message. See you Saturday.
